question_bank.title: AI & ML Developer Interview Question Bank — 500 Questions
question_bank.description: AI/ML Developer interview bank covering AI fundamentals, classical ML, statistics, supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, evaluation, deep learning, computer vision, NLP/Transformers, Generative AI/LLMs, MLOps, and production AI system design.
design_notes: Uses the same universal question-object schema as the Python and Backend banks.
Contains 500 question records with no draft slots.
Difficulty distribution: Easy 100, Medium 150, Hard 150, Expert 100.
Designed specifically for an AI/ML Developer role, with classical ML, statistics, deep learning, computer vision, NLP/Transformers, Generative AI/LLMs, MLOps, and production AI system design.
Evaluation metadata supports rubric-based AI scoring and contextual follow-up questions.
